scope: Editorial checkpoint for four Overview fields, IPA text and contextual Tamil meaning. Not a complete lesson, import payload, recorded-audio asset, or app-update claim.

tamilMeaning.value: திட்டமிட்டபடி இலக்கை நோக்கி முன்னேறிக் கொண்டிருப்பது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Figurative planning expression: progress is compared with staying on the correct route toward a destination.
proposedProfile.connotation: Positive and reassuring here: the review is progressing as planned.
proposedProfile.tone: Confident and matter-of-fact here: the speaker expects the Thursday target to be met.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral and common in everyday and professional planning. It can describe schedules, budgets or goals.

tamilMeaning.value: தொடங்கியுள்ளதாலும் இன்னும் முடிவடையாத நிலையில் இருப்பது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: State expression meaning that an activity has started but is not yet complete.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral: it reports the current stage without implying success, delay or failure.
proposedProfile.tone: Factual and status-focused here: “still” emphasizes that the final check continues.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral; natural in everyday updates, workplace reports and system-status messages.

tamilMeaning.value: ஏதாவது செய்ய விருப்பமாக அல்லது தயாராக இருப்பது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Informal idiomatic phrase asking whether someone is willing or interested in an activity.
proposedProfile.connotation: Positive and inviting here: the walk is offered as an optional shared activity.
proposedProfile.tone: Friendly and low-pressure here: the question leaves the listener free to accept or decline.
proposedProfile.register: Informal conversation. “Would you be interested in…” is more suitable for a formal invitation.

tamilMeaning.value: மற்றவருக்கு நியாயமாக வசதியான மிக விரைவான நேரத்தில்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Polite time phrase requesting action as soon as the other person's circumstances reasonably allow.
proposedProfile.connotation: Polite on the surface, but it can carry mild pressure because a prompt response is expected.
proposedProfile.tone: Formal and courteous here: “please” softens the request for the signed form.
proposedProfile.register: Formal workplace and administrative English. Use a clear deadline when the timing is genuinely important.

tamilMeaning.value: நிச்சயமின்மை காரணமாகச் செயல்படுவதற்கு முன் தயங்குவது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract verb for pausing or holding back because of uncertainty; here, uncertainty about sharing views.
proposedProfile.connotation: Slightly negative here because hesitation prevents open participation, though hesitation can also show care.
proposedProfile.tone: Encouraging and inclusive here: the speaker invites hesitant people to speak honestly.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral and common in everyday and professional English. The OCR-spaced source remains understandable but should not be treated as clean quotation text.

tamilMeaning.value: இனிமேல் அல்லது எதிர்கால நடவடிக்கைகளில்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Discourse phrase that shifts attention to a policy or practice from the present point onward.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral to constructive here: it introduces a simpler future reporting practice.
proposedProfile.tone: Decisive and forward-looking here: the speaker announces what will change.
proposedProfile.register: Common in workplace speech and writing. “From now on” is usually clearer in ordinary conversation.

tamilMeaning.value: பகிரப்பட்ட பண்புகள் அல்லது அனுபவங்களால் உருவாகும் நெருக்கமான தொடர்புணர்வு

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract extension of family relationship: a felt connection based on shared qualities or experience.
proposedProfile.connotation: Positive here: even difficult people are presented as capable of mutual connection.
proposedProfile.tone: Reflective and hopeful here: the passage emphasizes shared humanity despite difficulty.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral to literary; natural in reflective writing and thoughtful conversation. It need not imply a biological family relationship.

tamilMeaning.value: ஏதாவது ஒன்றைப் பயன்படுத்துவதையோ வழங்குவதையோ படிப்படியாக நிறுத்துவது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Phrasal verb for ending use or provision gradually rather than all at once.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral here: the phrase describes the transition method, not whether ending paper forms is good or bad.
proposedProfile.tone: Planned and practical here: the sentence states a gradual change with a deadline.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral to professional; common in policy, technology and product planning. Name the replacement when readers need operational clarity.

tamilMeaning.value: ஒருவர் கொடுக்கும் சைகையின்போது தொடங்குவது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Set phrase meaning when another person gives the signal to begin; the cue can be spoken, visual or contextual.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral by itself: it shows coordinated timing, while the negative judgement comes from “yammer” and “incoherently.”
proposedProfile.tone: Mocking and critical here: the narration presents Royce's speech as long and confused.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral in staged, coordinated or narrative contexts. The damaged OCR limits confidence in punctuation but not in this sense.

tamilMeaning.value: முடிவை நிர்ணயிக்கும் அளவுக்கு மிகவும் முக்கியமான

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract adjective meaning extremely important to the result; here, data preparation strongly affects later work.
proposedProfile.connotation: Emphatic and importance-marking, but not positive or negative by itself.
proposedProfile.tone: Instructional and emphatic here: the course highlights a step learners must not overlook.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral to formal; common in professional, academic and everyday explanation. “Very crucial” is redundant in careful edited English.

tamilMeaning.value: நாம் எந்த முடிவை அல்லது தரநிலையை அடைய முயல்கிறோம் என்று கேட்பது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Conversational planning question used to identify the desired result or standard.
proposedProfile.connotation: Constructive and goal-focused here: it invites shared clarity before work proceeds.
proposedProfile.tone: Collaborative and practical here: “we” frames the first-month target as a group concern.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral; natural in meetings and everyday planning. A formal document may use “What is the objective?”

tamilMeaning.value: ஆழமில்லாத நீரில் நடந்து சென்றார்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Literal past-tense verb for walking through shallow water, which makes movement slower or more effortful than ordinary walking.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral here: it describes physical movement without praising or criticizing it.
proposedProfile.tone: Simple and descriptive here: the repeated action shows Wilbur following her into the brook.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral narrative vocabulary. The base form is “wade”; this entry records the past form used in the sentence.

tamilMeaning.value: நோக்கமிட்ட பாதை, பொருள் அல்லது இலக்கிலிருந்து விலகுவது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Figurative expression comparing departure from a topic or goal with leaving the correct physical route.
proposedProfile.connotation: Negative and cautionary here: greater deviation makes recovery more difficult.
proposedProfile.tone: Warning and explanatory here: the sentence stresses the increasing cost of moving farther away from the intended course.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral and common in coaching, meetings and planning. The OCR is damaged, but the conditional warning remains clear.

tamilMeaning.value: வாயிலிருந்து வெளியேறும் உமிழ்நீர்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Literal informal noun for saliva expelled from the mouth; here, droplets are sprayed while shouting.
proposedProfile.connotation: Unpleasant here because it emphasizes loss of control and an uncomfortable physical detail.
proposedProfile.tone: Vivid and mocking here: exaggerated bodily details portray the angry denial as extreme.
proposedProfile.register: Informal everyday vocabulary. “Saliva” is the neutral clinical term; the OCR-damaged quotation should not be reused as polished example text.

tamilMeaning.value: அனைத்து பொறுப்புகளையும் சமாளிக்க போதிய நேரமோ திறனோ இல்லாத நிலை

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Figurative idiom comparing limited time or capacity with material stretched so far that it becomes thin.
proposedProfile.connotation: Negative and concerned here: staff absence is expected to leave insufficient capacity.
proposedProfile.tone: Cautious and practical here: “likely” predicts pressure without claiming certainty.
proposedProfile.register: Conversational to neutral professional English. Specify whether the shortage concerns staff, time, money or attention when needed.

tamilMeaning.value: இரு தரப்பினராலும் பகிரப்பட்ட அல்லது அனுபவிக்கப்பட்ட வகையில்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract adverb showing that something applies to, is shared by or benefits both sides; here, a solution would satisfy both.
proposedProfile.connotation: Positive in “mutually satisfactory” because both parties would benefit, though the passage says such a result seems impossible to him.
proposedProfile.tone: Pessimistic here: “no possibility” rejects hope of a solution acceptable to both sides.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral to formal; common in negotiation, relationships and professional writing. The OCR is damaged but the grammatical role is clear.

tamilMeaning.value: மக்கள் ஒன்றாக எவ்வாறு பணிபுரிவார்கள் என்பதை நிர்ணயிக்கும் ஒப்புக்கொண்ட நடைமுறை விதிகள்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Professional noun phrase for practical rules a group agrees to follow while working together.
proposedProfile.connotation: Collaborative and constructive here: the group has made expectations explicit.
proposedProfile.tone: Matter-of-fact and procedural here: the sentence states the agreed rule for urgent requests.
proposedProfile.register: Professional but not necessarily legal. Do not confuse it with an employment contract or another binding legal agreement.

tamilMeaning.value: விரும்பத்தகாத செய்தி அல்லது மாற்றத்தின் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள எளிதாகக் குறைப்பது

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Figurative idiom: reducing emotional harm is compared with making a physical blow less severe.
proposedProfile.connotation: Mixed here: the promotion and higher pay reduce distress but do not remove the disruption of displacement.
proposedProfile.tone: Pragmatic and cautiously reassuring here: benefits are presented as compensation for an unwelcome move.
proposedProfile.register: Neutral conversational and professional English. Avoid it if the wording would minimize serious harm.

tamilMeaning.value: ஒரு கூற்றை ஆதரிக்கும் சான்றுகளை வழங்க வேண்டிய பொறுப்பு

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract legal and reasoning term for the responsibility to support a claim with sufficient evidence.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral, but it assigns responsibility to the claimant rather than to people who question the claim.
proposedProfile.tone: Firm and analytical here: the sentence states who must demonstrate that the change saves money.
proposedProfile.register: Formal to professional; common in law, debate and evidence-based decision-making. The required standard of proof depends on the setting.

tamilMeaning.value: முன்னர் கூறியதை ஆதரிக்க மேலும் ஒரு காரணத்தைச் சேர்க்கப் பயன்படும் இணைப்புச் சொல்

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Logical connector adding another reason to support the preceding preference.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral by itself; here it strengthens the case for an earlier meeting with a practical reason.
proposedProfile.tone: Mildly persuasive and conversational here: the second sentence adds supporting evidence.
proposedProfile.register: Common in conversation and informal writing. “In addition” is more formal; “beside” without -s has a different meaning.
